def find_longest_palindrome(s):
    n = len(s)
    longest_palindrome = ""

    for i in range(n):
        # Check for odd length palindromes with center at i
        l, r = i, i
        while l >= 0 and r < n and s[l] == s[r]:
            palindrome = s[l:r + 1]
            if len(palindrome) > len(longest_palindrome):
                prefix = s[:l]
                suffix = s[r + 1:]
                if prefix == s[:l] and suffix == s[r + 1:]:
                    longest_palindrome = palindrome
            l -= 1
            r += 1

        # Check for even length palindromes with center at i, i+1
        l, r = i, i + 1
        while l >= 0 and r < n and s[l] == s[r]:
            palindrome = s[l:r + 1]
            if len(palindrome) > len(longest_palindrome):
                prefix = s[:l]
                suffix = s[r + 1:]
                if prefix == s[:l] and suffix == s[r + 1:]:
                    longest_palindrome = palindrome
            l -= 1
            r += 1

    return longest_palindrome
